led_controllers.notes: DO NOT USE PINS FROM HERE - Use Config.py for pin assignments. This section is for reference only to document the intended GPIO pins for each strip. All strips should be on separate pins to allow for independent control and animation patterns.

strip_sky_arc.description: Continuous 48-inch sky arc: dawn (12") → noon bright (24") → dusk (12"). Forms complete data chain for sun traversal effect.

segments.name: Dawn Sky Gradient
segments.purpose: Pink/purple gradient as sun rises (left side of diorama)

segments.name: Day Sky
segments.purpose: Bright white RGBW for intense daylight (center, high-density 144/m)

segments.name: Dusk Sky Gradient
segments.purpose: Orange/amber gradient as sun sets (right side of diorama)

strip_type_zones.note: noon segment — RGBW, W channel is additive white

sun_tracker.name: The Sun
sun_tracker.description: 3-pixel warm-white light that traverses the 48-inch arc dawn→noon→dusk. Center pixel ranges from 0 to 126. Active during day hours only. Color tuple length (3 or 4) must match the strip_type_zone at the current pixel position.

moon_tracker.name: The Moon
moon_tracker.description: 3-pixel cool blue-white light that traverses the same 48-inch arc as the sun but in reverse (dusk→noon→dawn). Active during night hours only. Mutually exclusive with sun_tracker. Color tuple length (3 or 4) must match the strip_type_zone at the current pixel position.

strip_ground_effects.description: Ground-level terrain features on GPIO 4. Single WS2812B chain routed left-to-right by x-coordinate through the diorama.

segments.name: Smial 1
segments.purpose: 3 warm pixels for hobbit hole window interior glow.

segments.name: Smial 2
segments.purpose: 3 warm pixels for second hobbit hole window interior glow.

segments.name: The Bridge
segments.purpose: 14 pixels of low-intensity path lighting across 9-inch bridge span.

segments.name: Smial 3 - Lower Window
segments.purpose: 2 warm pixels for lower window of Smial 3.

segments.name: Smial 3 - Main Entrance
segments.purpose: 5 warm pixels for the main entrance and interior of Smial 3.

segments.name: Smial 3 - Upper Window
segments.purpose: 2 warm pixels for upper window of Smial 3.

segments.name: The Party Tree
segments.purpose: 15 pixels for hanging colored lanterns and fireworks bursts.

segments.name: Server Room Edge
segments.purpose: 20 pixels for ambient and diagnostic edge lighting around the 1x1 foot server room enclosure.

segments.name: Path Lanterns
segments.purpose: 6 warm amber pixels along the bridge approach path. Dim with time of day; off at noon, brightest at dusk and dawn.

segments.name: Fireflies
segments.purpose: 12 naked LEDs scattered across the low meadow. Each pixel twinkles independently with a randomized fade-in/fade-out timer. Warm yellow-green. Active at dusk and night only.

segments.name: Star Field
segments.purpose: 10 pixels terminating into the fiber optics bundle. Cold white sparkle pattern. Independent of fireflies. Fades in after dusk, fades out at dawn.

segments.name: Storm Clouds
segments.purpose: 10 pixels hidden behind cloud cutout above the Party Tree. Used for rapid white strobe during storm preset instead of the full-strip flash in preset #9.

segments.name: Smial 1 Chimney
segments.purpose: 2 warm flickering pixels aimed up into the chimney opening of Smial 1. Activates when fogger relay is on to illuminate rising smoke.

segments.name: Smial 2 Chimney
segments.purpose: 2 warm flickering pixels aimed up into the chimney opening of Smial 2. Activates when fogger relay is on to illuminate rising smoke.

segments.name: Smial 3 Chimney
segments.purpose: 3 warm flickering pixels aimed up into the chimney of Smial 3. Activates when fogger relay is on. 3 pixels for proportionally larger structure.

segments.name: Bridge Morning Mist
segments.purpose: 8 cool blue-white pixels mounted beneath the bridge deck facing upward. Creates a mist glow effect. Activates at dawn time window and during fog events (GPIO 18).

strip_water_effects.description: WS2812B strip on GPIO 5 for river shimmer effect. Main lights positioned into the EDGE of acrylic base of the stream.
strip_water_effects.purpose: Tail lights for redirected filament piping, main (left, head, right) underlighting of stream. Independent of the main ground strip pixels to allow for different animation patterns and brightness levels.

segments.name: Stream Tail
segments.purpose: 6 pixels along the Tail of the acrylic base of the stream.

segments.name: Stream Left
segments.purpose: 26 pixels along the Left Side of the acrylic base of the stream.

segments.name: Stream Head
segments.purpose: 27 pixels along the Head of the acrylic base of the stream.

segments.name: Stream Right
segments.purpose: 27 pixels along the Right Side of the acrylic base of the stream.
